description: The complete Turkey income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Wages per employer: SGK and unemployment with the 9× ceiling, insurance premiums, disability allowance, wage tariff, minimum-wage exemption, stamp duty; When wages must be declared (several employers, ₺400,000 and ₺5,300,000 tests) and the 75 Seri No. Sirküler wage split; Rental income: ₺58,000 housing exemption and its limits, lump-sum 15% vs actual expenses (both computed), workplace rent withholding; Investment income: deposit withholding, dividends half exempt with the ₺400,000 test, unwithheld income over ₺22,000; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in TRY; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: An individual's Turkish income tax for calendar year 2026 (return in March 2027). Amounts in Turkish lira (₺) for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

age.description: Age (used for the young entrepreneur exemption, under 29). Default 35

bagkur_paid.description: Bağ-Kur contributions paid, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

commercial_profit.description: Net commercial profit from the books (ticari kazanç), may be negative

professional_receipts.description: Professional receipts (serbest meslek kazancı), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

professional_withheld.description: 20% withheld by business clients (stopaj), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

provisional_tax_paid.description: Provisional tax paid (geçici vergi), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

young_entrepreneur.description: Young entrepreneur exemption applies (under 29 at the start, first 3 years): ₺400,000 of profit exempt

donations_full.description: Donations deductible in full: schools, health facilities, Kızılay, Yeşilay, presidential campaigns, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

donations_limited.description: Donations to public bodies, public-benefit associations, tax-exempt foundations; at most 5% of declared income, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

health_education.description: Health and education spending in Turkey for you, spouse, minor children; at most 10% of declared income, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

life_premiums.description: Life insurance with savings for you, spouse, minor children (50% counts), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

personal_premiums.description: Death, accident, health, disability or education insurance (100% counts); with life insurance at most 15% of income and ₺396,360, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

priority_region.description: Those donations went to a priority development region (limit 10%)

dependants_disability.description: Disability degree of each disabled person you support (wage earners get their allowance too)

items.description: Degree: 0 none, 1 (80%+ loss of working capacity), 2 (60%+), 3 (40%+)

disability.description: Your disability degree (engellilik derecesi); allowance 12,000 / 7,000 / 3,000 a month. Default 0: 0 none, 1 (80%+ loss of working capacity), 2 (60%+), 3 (40%+)

employers.description: Each employer in Turkey in 2026, highest-paid first or in any order (at most 10)

gross.description: Gross wages incl. bonuses and taxable benefits (brüt ücret), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

social_security.description: Employee SGK + unemployment actually deducted; default 15% up to the ceiling ₺297,270 a month, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

withheld.description: Income tax withheld on the payslips (after the minimum-wage exemption); default worked out, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

withheld_before_exemption.description: Income tax before the minimum-wage exemption (what the return credits); default withheld + exemption, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

foreign.description: Income from abroad (residents only; at most 20)

amount.description: Gross amount in lira, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

kind.description: salary, interest, dividends, rent or other

social_contributions.description: Compulsory social contributions paid abroad on a salary, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

tax_paid.description: Tax paid abroad, in lira, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

incidental.description: Incidental gains (arızi kazanç), e.g. one-off commissions; ₺350,000 exempt, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

deposit_interest.description: TL deposit interest and participation-bank profit shares, gross (taxed at source, never declared), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

deposit_rate.description: Withholding rate on deposits: 0.175 up to 6 months, 0.15 up to 1 year, 0.10 longer. Default 0.175

dividend_withheld.description: Dividend withholding; default 15% of gross, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

dividends.description: Dividends from Turkish companies, gross (kâr payı); half exempt, 15% withheld, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

other_source_taxed.description: Funds, bonds and other income taxed at source under geçici 67, gross, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

other_source_taxed_withheld.description: Tax withheld on that income, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

unwithheld.description: Interest or investment income with nothing withheld (e.g. interest on a private loan), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

payment_date.description: Date you pay the balance, YYYY-MM-DD; after 31 March / 31 July 2027 a surcharge of 3.7% a month applies

pension.description: SGK retirement pension (exempt; shown for information), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

actual_expenses.description: Actual expenses for all let property: repairs, insurance, property tax, depreciation (no housing loan interest), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

housing.description: Rent from homes let as homes (konut), gross; ₺58,000 a year exempt, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

method.description: Expenses: lump (götürü gider, 15% of rent) or actual (gerçek gider). Both are computed. Default lump

unwithheld.description: Other rent with nothing withheld (e.g. workplace let to a private person), Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

workplace_withheld.description: Rent from a workplace let to a business that withheld 20% (iş yeri), gross, Turkish lira (₺) for 2026

residency.description: Tax residence: resident (tam mükellef, taxed on worldwide income) or nonResident (dar mükellef, only income from Turkey). Default resident

residency_facts.description: Optional: work out the residence from these facts instead of `residency`

days_in_turkey.description: Days in Turkey in 2026 (temporary trips abroad count as in Turkey)

domicile_in_turkey.description: Your domicile (yerleşim yeri, the place you mean to settle) is in Turkey

temporary_purpose.description: In Turkey only for a business trip, study, medical treatment, rest or travel (GVK 5)

sales.description: Sales of shares, securities and property (at most 30)

inherited.description: Acquired by inheritance (always exempt for property)

type.description: bist (shares on Borsa İstanbul), unlisted (shares of a Turkish company), foreign (foreign shares and securities), property (land, buildings, homes)

ufe_bought.description: Yİ-ÜFE producer price index of the month before purchase (for indexation)

ufe_sold.description: Yİ-ÜFE of the month before sale
